sections.description: What it replaces and what it covers.

Kubota built the M500TR's core rotor to remove that step: one rotor, newly developed, sufficient on its own for use across various microtube formats.

The machine still scales beyond that single rotor when the work calls for it — bottle rotors up to 500 mL and plate rotor options extend the M500TR across the fuller range Kubota lists in its typical rotor and accessory set.

sections.description: Learn how the Kubota Model S300T runs different tube sizes together in the same load. A routine day in most labs produces a mix, some long blood collection tubes, some short, occasionally a batch needing both 15 mL and 50 mL tubes spun at once. A centrifuge that only runs one tube size per load turns that mix into multiple separate spins. S300T's mixed-loading capability removes the bottleneck directly, long and short tubes run together, 15 mL and 50 mL TC tubes run together, no sort-and-batch step required.

sections.description: Discover how fast imbalance detection on the Kubota Model S300T protects samples and equipment.
